content:
zoe: Security advisory: discovery scan found several long-lived SSH keys and local accounts with password auth on a small set of DB bastion VMs (prod-db-bastion-1/2). This increases blast radius if a key is leaked. Action required: rotate keys, disable password auth, and move to short-lived certs via our CA. Deadline: 2026-04-07 23:59 UTC.

sec-bot: Finding RW-SERVER-224: long-lived-ssh-keys detected. Affected hosts: prod-db-bastion-1, prod-db-bastion-2. See ticket RW-Sec-912.

nate: Ack. I own the bastion instances. Plan: publish new host CA-signed certs, add cert auth to sshd_config, and revoke old keys in authorized_keys. I'll stage on prod-db-bastion-staging first.

emily: I manage DB ops that use these bastions. Will update my jumpbox configs to use signed certs; please post the CA public key and a short migration checklist.

infra-oncall: Maintenance window suggested: 2026-04-05 01:00-02:00 UTC. We'll coordinate reboots if needed.

zoe: Quick checklist for owners to post after work: `owner: host - action: rotated/disabled - auth: certs/passwords-disabled - notes`

sec-bot: Recommended commands/snippets:
```bash
# generate ephemeral cert via internal CA (example)
ssh-keygen -t rsa -f userkey
ssh-ca sign --user userkey.pub --ttl 8h > user-cert.pub
# deploy CA in sshd (authorized by /etc/ssh/sshd_config)
```

nate: owner: prod-db-bastion-1 - action: rotated - auth: certs - notes: staging ok, rolling to prod in window.

emily: owner: prod-db-bastion-2 - action: rotated - auth: certs - notes: verified DB connections from app clusters, no failures.

zoe: Follow-up: we'll add a CI check to fail image builds that contain embedded private keys and add scanning to detect password auth enabled on images. If you find any scripts that still inject keys, please remove them and open RW-Sec-912. Thanks all. :lock:
